{"consolidated_memory":"SPURIOUS 429 RATE LIMITER ISSUES IN api/gateway/rate_limit.go

Six separate bugs fixed in the rate limiter, same component, spanning 2026-01-11 to 2026-05-15. All reported the same signal: throttle counters far above the configured ceiling. Repro method across all: replay the saved burst fixture. Stack: Go. Covering test: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go.

OCCASION 1: 2026-01-11 (c020-e0)
Trigger: input list came in empty
Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR #1362, branch fix/spurious-429-1
Result: reclaimed 86 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2: 2026-01-17 (c020-e1)
Trigger: traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
Root cause: error swallowed by a bare except
Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
PR #1633, branch fix/spurious-429-2
Result: memory settled at 183 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

OCCASION 3: 2026-03-02 (c020-e2)
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #6640, branch fix/spurious-429-3
Result: cold start dropped 25 percent, to 692 ms

OCCASION 4: 2026-03-21 (c020-e3)
Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
Fix: switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
PR #6815, branch fix/spurious-429-4
Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 29 days running

OCCASION 5: 2026-05-03 (c020-e4)
Trigger: on the staging read replica
Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
PR #7389, branch fix/spurious-429-5
Result: job finished in 12 minutes instead of 7 hours

OCCASION 6: 2026-05-15 (c020-e5)
Trigger: when two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: listener registered but never removed
Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR #8071, branch fix/spurious-429-6
Result: backlog cleared 62 minutes after the deploy"}
